growth_epochs.caveat: Internal epoch boundaries use the first normal0.5s-cadence snapshot at/after the target; exact warmup and measurement endpoints use embedded native boundaries. Interval latency populations are completions in those actual per-replica intervals.

latency_endpoint: local producer insertion immediately before signed batch production to post-handler local materialization; completed-in-window population
traffic_boundary: successful native replica TCP stream writes including authenticated frame and ACK bytes; excludes proxy duplicate writes, control, TCP/IP headers, kernel retransmissions
interpretation: Every requested repeat is retained; overloaded valid windows are not discarded or replaced. Correctness passing and full drain are separate from steady-state performance.
Finite-window throughput and latency do not establish bounded steady-state input age; per-trial pending/gap deltas and growth epochs remain explicit.
Reported medians and ranges summarize three observations. Per-trial latency-quantile medians are not pooled transaction quantiles. No statistical significance or maximum sustainable-throughput claim.
All four replicas and the asynchronous delay proxy share one machine.10ms delay is per userspace TCP chunk in each direction, not a kernel packet-delay preset.
Latency population includes origin-local transactions that completed inside each native measurement window; warmup backlog may affect throughput.

delay_method.scope: Userspace FIFO byte-stream chunks; release eligibility at read timestamp plus requested delay. Scheduling can add delay. TCP handshake is not delayed.
delay_method.all_observation_delay_fields: Each trial record includes its own calibration RTT and observed mean/maximum chunk delay.

owned_cpu_snapshot.caveat: One owned-process ps snapshot at35s; not integrated window CPU usage.

runner_target_met_definition.generation_target_met: achieved generation >= 95% of configured offered rate
runner_target_met_definition.completion_target_met: achieved completion >= 95% of configured offered rate
runner_target_met_definition.interpretation: These finite-window acceptance flags do not mean exact offered load is sustained or that pending/input age is bounded.

separate_final_diagnostic.classification: instrumented causal tracing plus one five-second replica0 sample; excluded from all rate medians and ranges
separate_final_diagnostic.interpretation: Input readiness waits on HISTORY3 while exact matched-round CER/admission phase increases. Small ongoing runtime/queue/network overhead compounds; the diagnostic does not identify a unique cross-replica bottleneck or establish hardware CPU utilization.
